risks.title: Growth
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions risks related to its growth strategy, including difficulties in finding suitable real estate, high costs associated with hiring and training new employees, and challenges in maintaining corporate culture.

risks.title: Inflation
risks.score_rationale: Inflation is mentioned as a factor that could impact profitability and cash flows, primarily due to rising labor, energy, and raw material costs.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The company highlights risks related to supply chain disruptions, including shortages of parts and equipment, and difficulties in identifying alternative suppliers.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition is cited as a factor that could affect profitability and market share, particularly due to the presence of aggressive competitors in the market. The top 5 LTL carriers represent 56% of the market in 2024.

risks.title: Fuel-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company identifies fuel-related risks, particularly due to volatility in pricing and diesel availability. Fuel surcharges are indexed to diesel prices published by the U.S. Department of Energy.

risks.title: Acquisition-Related Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company notes risks related to acquisitions, including integration challenges and high associated costs.

ai_positioning.summary: ODFL has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in the provided excerpts from its 10-K filing. Therefore, its positioning on AI cannot be determined from this information.
